scope: Post-hoc diagnostic of the four fixed step20 validation endpoints; not an additional primary endpoint, seed selection or significance proof
distance_definition: Shortest number of cardinal actions from the initial S to G on the deterministic is_slippery=False map, avoiding H. Derived independently by BFS on actual env.P/action_map transitions. Wall collisions consume a rollout turn but do not shorten BFS distance; invalid commands are not edges of a shortest path. This is not the model actual-turn count or a per-turn visited-state stratification.
random_policy: Every nonterminal turn independently choose each valid direction command with probability 1/4, including wall and hole moves. Absorb hole/goal; stop at 10 actions. No language generation, model sampling or Monte Carlo draws.
limitations: The four arms revisit the same 43 farther tasks; do not call 688 trajectories independent task evidence.
All per-distance results are post-hoc descriptive subsets, some with few tasks; no new hypothesis-test claims or checkpoint selection.
Random-policy values are exact policy expectations averaged across the same task subset, not an observed finite-sample score or proof of superiority.
Pass4 averages per-task 1-(1-p_i)^4 for four independent random trajectories; applying the power to the overall average success is incorrect.
Distance alone does not characterize map difficulty; size, holes and branching geometry also differ across strata.
The primary results remain the original fixed step20 observations, not repeated final or a midpoint maximum.
